description: Reviews API: Get a Booking.com property. A Booking.com property as an `Entity`: guest score out of 10 and review count; address, coordinates, stars, aspect scores (staff, cleanliness, location...), reviews per score band and per language in `extra`. Price: 8 credits per call; failed calls are free.

hotel_id.description: Country code and page name of the property URL (`booking.com/hotel/fr/ibis-budget-paris-porte-de-bercy.html` → `fr-ibis-budget-paris-porte-de-bercy`), or the numeric property ID returned by the search (`id`, e.g. `537945`)

name: reviews_booking_hotel
title: Get a Booking.com property
